lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not identify which existing list behaviors must remain unchanged when the new option is absent or combined with existing options.
lenses.observable_signal: Running previously valid list invocations changes their output, ordering, exit status, formatting, or accepted arguments.
lenses.why_material: The fixed requirement explicitly makes behavior preservation a condition of success, so an incomplete compatibility boundary permits regressions.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Compare representative pre-change list invocations against the same invocations after implementation, including no options and existing option combinations.

lenses.failure_description: The externally visible meaning of “overdue” is not settled for items due today, items with timestamps, items without due dates, and completed items.
lenses.observable_signal: Different reasonable implementations return different item sets for the same stored tasks and current time.
lenses.why_material: The filter cannot be implemented or accepted consistently without a precise inclusion boundary.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Evaluate the filtered output for one item in each boundary class: past due, due exactly now or today, future due, no due date, and completed past due.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves unspecified which clock, date boundary, or time zone determines whether an item is overdue.
lenses.observable_signal: The same data produces different filtered results when executed near a day boundary or under different local time settings.
lenses.why_material: Time-dependent classification can become nondeterministic across environments and can fail specifically at boundary times.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run classification for fixed due values and a fixed current instant under at least two time zones, including a value near midnight.

lenses.failure_description: The requirements do not define how the new filter composes with existing filters, sorting, pagination, output modes, or invalid argument combinations.
lenses.observable_signal: Combined invocations either ignore an option, apply operations in inconsistent order, reject previously valid syntax, or produce an undocumented subset.
lenses.why_material: An optional command flag becomes part of the public interaction surface, and undefined composition prevents a complete implementation contract.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise the new option alone and paired with each existing list-affecting option, checking result membership, ordering, formatting, exit status, and error behavior.

lenses.failure_description: Verification demonstrates that some overdue items are shown but does not prove exclusion boundaries or preservation of unfiltered behavior.
lenses.observable_signal: Tests pass even when future, undated, or completed items are incorrectly included, or when ordinary list output has changed.
lenses.why_material: A positive-only check can validate the presence of the feature while missing materially incorrect filtering and compatibility regressions.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Use a mixed dataset containing every inclusion and exclusion boundary, then verify both filtered membership and byte- or structure-equivalent unfiltered output.
